_comment: ei-json baseline digest for the axibridge byte-identity guard (M17 Task 2). See ei-byte-identity.test.mjs for the regeneration procedure. Regenerated 2026-08-21, during MPVE. The baseline had been STALE since v1.4.0 -- it was last captured at c3b59a8 (2026-08-18) and two releases moved the document without anyone recapturing it, so this guard was already red before MPVE touched it. The drift is +86,605 chars, attributed by top-level key: players +77,314 and buffMap +9,088 (v1.4.0's buff/skill naming work) and skillMap +203. MPVE itself contributed ZERO bytes here, which was verified rather than assumed: a v1.4.1 worktree build and the MPVE build produce the SAME length and the SAME sha256 (4c53bf51...) on this WvW fixture. That is the expected result -- every new field is `skip_serializing_if = Option::is_none` and `None` for WvW, and both target-selection branches reduce to the old `is_player` rule for a WvW log. A PvE fixture would exercise the new fields; this guard deliberately stays WvW-only, since its job is to prove axibridge's existing consumption did not move.
